learningOutcome: Learners distinguish short fun from longer-lasting value and pause before impulse buys.
conceptTruth: Money spent on impulse rarely returns.
behaviourShift: Pause before purchase when urgency is manufactured.
newPossibility: Saving for a meaningful goal beats a fleeting treat.
ruleEnforcement: Use the 24-hour freeze when a deal feels urgent.

focus: Needs vs wants under budget pressure
learningOutcome: Learners sort needs from wants and protect money for promises and essentials.
conceptTruth: Needs keep you safe; wants feel good now.
behaviourShift: Check needs before wants when money is limited.
newPossibility: Promises to others are needs worth protecting.
ruleEnforcement: Never spend the last dollar on a want before needs are covered.

focus: Setting money aside for future needs
learningOutcome: Learners allocate part of income to a reserve before spending.
conceptTruth: Future-you deserves a slice of today's money.
behaviourShift: Move money to a reserve before optional spending.
newPossibility: A reserve turns panic into a plan.
ruleEnforcement: Always protect the amount you need next week before buying wants.

learningOutcome: Learners recognize social pressure and use pause tools under hype.
conceptTruth: Friends' excitement is not your budget plan.
behaviourShift: Pause when peers push you to spend.
newPossibility: You can opt out without losing friendships.
ruleEnforcement: Use a pause tool when chat or friends rush a purchase.
